Bellandur Social · Bangalore · 29.07.2024

How it started

Introduced through family, at Bellandur Social, doing the very polite, very awkward "getting to know each other" thing two near-strangers do. It wasn't supposed to be a big deal — just one evening.

Somewhere in that conversation, you looked at me and said:

"Yaar app download krdoge kya yaar,
coordinate spoofing krni pdegiii"

I didn't need an app. Turns out I just needed you to keep talking. Here we are, a little over two years and one wedding date later.

The in-between days

Everything since

Meeting again, in Jaipur

"Arun Chacha ne bola isliye mil rhi huun"

Your honesty, even then, was doing all the work of convincing me this was worth showing up for again.

Papa's birthday, celebrated with you

Somewhere along the way "my family's celebrations" quietly became "our family's celebrations." I don't think either of us announced it — it just happened.

Her first birthday since we met

Red is the color for Mahiii — she looks absolutely gorgeous. Still new to each other, already showing up for the small things.

Then I asked

Marigolds on the floor, candles doing their job, and a question I'd been carrying around for a while, waiting for the right evening to put it down. You said yes before I'd even finished getting up off my knee.

You, meeting my parents

Turban and all, you walked into my house like you'd been coming over for years — and my parents adopted you roughly within the hour.

19.10.2025

We made it official

Both families in one room, garlands heavier than either of us expected, and a lot of happy crying from people who'd been waiting for this almost as much as we had. Rokafied.

Your birthday, 2025

Pink drapes, a neon sign that said what everyone already knew, and you — laughing about something only the two of us would find funny.

Christmas, 2025

They say love makes you gain weight… so yeah, we're head over heels and two sizes bigger!

Our first Valentine's Day

Celebrated in Kota, at Morgan's — the kind of ordinary-turned-extraordinary night that started making it clear this wasn't just "getting to know each other" anymore.

My birthday, your way

Fairy lights, candlelight, wine glasses you'd clearly thought about in advance. I've stopped being surprised at how much thought you put into these things.

The khat

For Mahiii

Dear Mahiii,I still remember the first time we met. I honestly didn't know what to expect, but talking to you felt so strangely natural—like I had already known you somewhere before. Right from day one, you were so open, playful, and completely yourself. I definitely didn't expect a girl I was meeting for the very first time to suddenly drop a line like: "Yeh app download karne ka try kar sakte ho kya please? Coordinate spoofing karni padegi, nahi toh company walon ko pata chal jaayega mai Bangalore aayi hui hoon." I absolutely loved your humor right then and there. That was the moment I realized I had to approach you again—you were completely my type of girl. Look at where that day led us. From meeting every single day, to the drama of "shaadi nahi ho sakti kyunki pandit ne mana kar diya," all the way to our Roka! We truly transformed this from an arranged marriage setup into a beautiful love story. We've faced our fair share of hardships and we're both still learning and improving every day, but I wouldn't trade this journey for anything. And now, here we are, set to get married on 25th October 2026. I couldn't be more excited to start my married life with you. I might not always be able to fulfill every single one of my own dreams, but I promise you this—I want to spend the rest of my life fulfilling yours.
Yours, always,
Shubham
25th October, 2026

Until I marry my best friend
